1. The N × 2N matrix (A B) is the upper half of a symplectic matrix if and only if ABT is symmetric and (A B) has maximal rank N.
candidates.proof_excerpt: It is easy to see that the rows of (A B) have zero symplectic product (with respect to the standard symplectic form on Q2N if and only if ABT is symmetric. In addition they span a vector space of rank N if and only if (A B) has maximal rank N. The result follows.
